title: measurement floor: seed noise of the recall fine-tune on Q, topo F1, lanes found, R@1 far (j1rc against j1eq, four seeds per arm)

a.recipe: j1rc = p16_train.py --design D7 --init e123_D7_r3_j1 --u 4 --lr 0.0005 --stem_lr 0.3 --w rec=3.0 (the exact E219.j1rc command), seeds 0 / 1 stored (e18_D7_j1rc, e18_D7_j1rcs1), seeds 2 / 3 new (e24_D7_j1rcs2, e24_D7_j1rcs3), fork_prune 0.4
a.note: all four evaluated with evaluate.py (new registry names e24_j1rc_s0..s3) so that topo_F1 and R@1_far are on the cards; stored seeds 0 / 1 are re-evaluated, not re-trained

c.recipe: j1eq = the same command with --w rec=1.0 (equal-budget control, E219.j1eq), seeds 0 / 1 stored (e18_D7_j1eq, e18_D7_j1eqs1), seeds 2 / 3 new (e24_D7_j1eqs2, e24_D7_j1eqs3), fork_prune 0.4

rule.note: same clause as E219: the weight must pay in Q, judged now on four paired seeds

kill: stop the pair of new fine-tunes if a final training loss deviates by more than 10 % from the stored seeds of the same arm (derail, BN running_var) or GPU memory exceeds 11 GB; a derailed seed is re-run once with the same seed and reported, never dropped silently
